channel.title: First State Update - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from First State Update (firststateupdate.com)

item.title: Man Seriously Injured In Bear-Area Fire
item.description: Fire crews responded to a trailer fire in the Kings Mill Trailer Park on North Dragon Drive in Bear Tuesday evening. Crews responded after an initial fire alarm dispatch escalated into a working incident with smoke visible on arrival. The first call was received at 7:17 p.m.

item.title: Man Succumbs To Injuries In Bear-Area Fire
item.description: Fire crews responded to a trailer fire in the Kings Mill Trailer Park on North Dragon Drive in Delaware City Tuesday evening. Crews responded after an initial fire alarm dispatch escalated into a working incident with smoke visible on arrival. The first call was received at 7:17 p.m.

item.title: Newark Police Identify Man Killed In Parkway Cross-Over Crash
item.description: Newark Police investigated a fatal crash on Christina Parkway late Saturday night after a head-on collision left one driver dead and two others injured. Officers were dispatched at approximately 10:06 p.m.

item.title: Ship Fire Injures Three At Port Of Wilmington
item.description: A large multi-agency response was dispatched to the Port of Wilmington on Tuesday morning after smoke was reported coming from a vessel docked at Berth 2. The initial alert was transmitted just before 9:30.

item.title: 2025: Released On Unsecured Bond In 2018, Alleged Pony Rapist Remains On The Lam
item.description: A man released in 2018 on unsecured bond is still wanted by Delaware authorities. As of November 26, 2025, Adelio A. Guzman remains at large and is still sought in connection with a case involving multiple charges.

item.title: Reports: Man In Wheelchair Struck By Vehicle Friday Morning
item.description: Emergency crews were dispatched to the intersection of West 8th and Washington streets in Wilmington just after 6:15 a.m. Friday for reports of a pedestrian struck by a vehicle. Upon arrival, first responders located an adult male who was in a wheelchair and had reportedly been struck by a vehicle.

item.title: Woman Injured In Rollover Crash Early Friday
item.description: A 35-year-old woman was transported for medical evaluation following a rollover crash early Friday morning on Interstate 95 northbound at the Sandbox Road in New Castle. The incident was reported at 3:02 a.m. as a rollover crash in the area of Interstate 95 northbound near the Sandbox.

item.title: Delaware State Trooper Struck Early Friday
item.description: A traffic collision involving a Delaware State Trooper was reported early Friday morning at the intersection of Old Churchmans Road and Don Avenue in New Castle's Duross Heights development. Emergency medical crews were dispatched at approximately 2:48 a.m.

item.title: Man Charged After Checkpoint Search
item.description: Delaware State Police arrested 22-year-old Wajahne Leggett of Wilmington on felony drug charges following a DUI checkpoint conducted early Thursday morning in New Castle.

item.title: Suspect Charged In Valero Robbery, Auto Theft
item.description: Delaware State Police arrested 29-year-old Donald Tinley Jr., of Milton, following a robbery investigation that began Monday morning in Sussex County. According to Delaware State Police, troopers were called at approximately 11:00 a.m.
